Anti_aspect_ratio_master: Creates an empty latent with Flux, Z-Image, and ERNIE-oriented presets plus manual or image-derived dimensions.
Antimatter_TextFileAppender: Saves text to TXT or JSON with append mode and scene-aware replacement for manual rework workflows.
Batch_Loader_From_Folder: Loads image batches directly from a local folder with random, sequential, freeze, skip, preview, and move-to-processed controls.
Antimetter_Video_Batch_Loader: Loads video batches from a local folder through VideoHelperSuite FFmpeg with random, sequential, freeze, skip, metadata, and move-to-processed controls.
AntiMatter_Video_Save_Popular: Popular-first alias for AntiMatter video saving. Saves IMAGE or LATENT frames as H.264/H.265/WEBM video to any local folder, with optional audio.
AntiMatter_Save_Video_in_Folder: Saves IMAGE or LATENT frames as video to any local folder path on any disk, with optional audio and H.264/H.265/WEBM settings.
AntiMatter_TextFilter: Filters and transforms incoming text with marker extraction, word/phrase removal, line/sentence/paragraph filters, replacement, regex, splitting, and cleanup tools.
LinePrompt_MasterLoad: Loads prompt lines from TXT files with sequential, random, reverse, freeze, prefix, delimiter, preview, and style-folder controls.
LinePrompt_MasterLoad_JSON: Loads scene prompts from JSON files with sequential, manual, or direct row selection and a Scene Name output for file naming.
LinePrompt_MasterLoad_JSON_Image: Loads scene prompts from JSON and the matching scene image from a folder by scene number, with sequential, manual, row, and interval modes.
LMStudioThreeImageAgent: Calls a local LM Studio OpenAI-compatible API with up to three image inputs and saves the text response plus request/response JSON.
LMStudioMultiInputSettingsAgent: Multi-route LM Studio agent with three optional image inputs, five text placeholders, per-route system/user prompts, project JSON saving, and combined text output.
